scope: Five DMC default renderer performance improvements with unchanged accepted pixels

performance.comparison: Our before/after on the same device; source FPS not measured
performance.timing_scope: Public render of device-resident full States and synchronization; includes State packing
performance.excluded: Source rollout, disk loading, initial transfer, batch indexing and initialization
performance.sampling: Larger batches repeat the 32 reached States; SD is sample SD

limitations: Default source-pixel gates retain the 0.001 threshold; generalization is bounded by the tested corpus.
DMC source physics remains CPU; source rendering uses llvmpipe on CPU and NVIDIA EGL on CUDA.
GPU stage timings exclude public upload/packing/output costs and are diagnostic only.
Exploratory rejected/failed probes are archived separately and confer no acceptance.
Final-eight family extensions are outside this report; differing unrelated source files are recorded explicitly.

archive_layout.accepted/cpu: CPU gate-v1 source cases and paired benchmark; original unit XML is superseded.
archive_layout.accepted/cpu-regressions: Supplemental gate-v4 complete CPU243 regression bundle with committed fixtures restored.
archive_layout.accepted/cuda: Only CUDA gate-v2 and its paired benchmark support CUDA acceptance.
archive_layout.diagnostics: Exploratory, failed and rejected runs; not acceptance evidence.
archive_layout.source-snapshots: Original complete source archives and manifests for each accepted gate.
